name: NEXUS Core Pod Alpha (Autonomous Compute Cluster)

specifications.telemetry_display: Integrated 7-inch portrait OLED diagnostic panel on rack door showing live token velocity and power consumption
specifications.led_array: 8x front-panel cyan activity LEDs per node; central amber safety status beacon at top of rack
specifications.cooling: Liquid-to-air closed loop with braided stainless steel coolant lines visible at rear
specifications.airgap_switch: Physical steel rotary keylock switch installed on front distribution rail

invariants: Rack 01 must show the physical keylock switch on the upper right rail
Status beacon pulses amber during autonomous execution spikes
OLED screen displays kernel thread graph and JSON tool call indicators
